label: Viber
terms_note: Messages reach SUBSCRIBED users only (one welcome message on conversation_started is the exception); broadcasts are marketing: <=300 receivers, 500 requests/10 s, text <=7,000 chars. Personal Viber accounts are never automated.

auth: 1. Since **2024-02-05 "Viber bots can only be created on commercial terms"** — apply to Rakuten Viber directly or
2. `POST /set_webhook` {url, event_types[], send_name, send_photo} — Viber calls back with `webhook` event.
3. Users become subscribers when they send their first message (or via a deep link); one welcome message may be sent
reference.limits: - broadcast_message rate limit 500 requests per 10 s; message text ≤ 7,000 chars; media by URL. - Commercial contract pricing (not published); Business Messages (database messaging) is a separate paid product. - Personal Viber accounts cannot be automated (human lane in the Messaging rules).

fields.name: auth_token
fields.help: Viber Channel authentication token: as the channel's super admin open the Channel info screen > Developer Tools > copy token. The Channels Post API takes it as the auth_token member of every JSON request body (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/). A webhook must have been set once with set_webhook before posting works (status 10 webhookNotSet otherwise).

config_fields.name: sender_id
config_fields.help: Viber user id of a Channel SUPER ADMIN, sent as `from` ('Only the superadmins' ID should be used as the sender ID with this API'); listed under members[] with role superadmin in get_account_info.

adapter.terms: Channel posts reach every channel subscriber; only channel super admins can obtain a token. Error status 12 tooManyRequests is a rate-control breach (no published numbers).

me.note: get_account_info returns {status, status_message, Id ('pa:...'), chat_hostname (channel name), background, members[{id, name, avatar, role superadmin|admin}]}.

publish_text.note: PUBLISHES to the Viber Channel: POST /pa/post {auth_token, from (config sender_id), type: 'text', text (max 7000 characters)}; subscribers see the channel name as sender. A non-zero status (2 invalidAuthToken, 4 missingData, 10 webhookNotSet, 12 tooManyRequests) is an error result. The page does not show a /post response body; `id` is message_token when Viber returns it (null otherwise). `reply_to` is ignored (no reply parameter).

publish_image.note: PUBLISHES a picture message to the Viber Channel: {type: 'picture', text (description, 'Required. Max 768 characters' - pass text, an empty string is allowed), media (the first image_urls entry: a JPEG URL with a .jpeg extension, max 1 MB; 'Only JPEG format is supported')}. Only the first image is posted; no thumbnail is sent.

not_offered.read_comments: The Channels Post API only posts: 'Posting to the Channel using the API, or when new messages are posted in the Channel by users will not generate a callback to this webhook', and no read endpoint is documented (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/).
not_offered.reply_comment: No reply or comment parameter exists on /pa/post; the documented message types are text, picture, video, file, location, contact, sticker, url (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/#message-types).
not_offered.read_mentions: No mentions or notifications endpoint is documented for channels (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/).
not_offered.delete: No delete / unsend endpoint is documented for channel posts (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/).
not_offered.analytics_post: No statistics endpoint is documented for channel posts (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/).
